The senate forced the Lontars to stop their aggression.|The Blood Carver [[Ke Daiv]] discusses his history with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>}}
'''This battle''' occurred when the [[Lontar]]s invaded the [[Blood Carver]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Batorine]]. The Lontars were successful and defeated the Blood Carvers, almost wiping out the species before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] intervened and brought the conflict to a halt. The battle took place hundreds of years prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
